name: Arc'teryx
why: Technical outdoor clothing — shells, insulation, packs — with laminated construction; the Veilance line applies it to plain city clothing.
origin: Founded in North Vancouver in 1989 as a climbing-harness maker; owned by Amer Sports since 2019.

notes.synth: GORE-TEX handled better than anyone — the technical ceiling of this map
notes.craft: Arc'teryx owns ARC'One in New Westminster, BC (480 workers), but says on its own site that ARC'One makes only about 5% of its product; the rest is made by partners in Asia and Central America. Its product pages name the actual factory and the fabric and dye countries (e.g. Beta Jacket: Pt. Pancaprima Ekabrothers, Indonesia), and it publishes a full partner list. Real owned making covering a small slice, plus the best factory disclosure in the batch: a 4.
notes.street: gorpcore's crown jewel — the shell in every city fit
notes.ski: A serious ski program inside a broader alpine technical house. The mountain is central but not exclusive, which is the difference between a four and a five here.

craft_evidence.owned_d: ARC'One, 425 Boyne Street, New Westminster, BC — Arc'teryx's own facility page (/explore/supply-chain-partners/arc-one): 480 workers, Arc'teryx Equipment 'a division of Amer Sports Canada', makes items across the outdoor collection, Veilance and LEAF (law enforcement/armed forces); 'what we learn and perfect in our own facility we then take to our facilities overseas'. Share: the brand's supply-chain page says '5% of our product in Canada at our own manufacturing facility, ARC'One'; its manufacturing-partners advice page says 'roughly 5% of our total production' (technical pieces such as Alpha SV, prototypes, limited runs). Owned by the brand's own Canadian entity (Amer Sports Canada); Amer Sports 2024 annual report mentions 'owned manufacturing sites' group-wide but gives no Arc'teryx breakdown.
craft_evidence.countries: Vietnam 3/8 (Gamma Pant, Covert Cardigan, Kopec 2 shoe), Bangladesh 2/8 (Atom, Thorium), Indonesia 1/8 (Beta), China 1/8 (Alpha SV), El Salvador 1/8 (Kyanite); Canada 0/8. Sample of 8 PDPs on arcteryx.com/us: shells, insulation, fleece, pants, footwear. Origin sits in a spec section; the fetcher saw it for versioned URLs (e.g. -0511) but not for unversioned URLs.
